Go port of the quantile-landmark histogram matching: the landmark table, the piecewise-linear mapping with its lower and upper segments, the thresholded histogram and Histogram::Quantile. Modified as listed in the file header: the histogram covers exactly [threshold, max] (landmarks stay monotonic), a reference histogram keeps its own threshold, the threshold is the exact float mean, non-finite samples are ignored and passed through, degenerate inputs are rejected, defaults are 1024 levels and 7 match points.

Modified port to Go of N4 bias field correction: the log-domain iteration, the histogram sharpening (Parzen histogram, zero padding, Gaussian Wiener deconvolution, E[u|v] mapping) and the convergence measure of N4BiasFieldCorrectionImageFilter, the single-level cubic B-spline approximation of BSplineScatteredDataPointSetToImageFilter, and the reconstruction and lattice refinement of BSplineControlPointImageFilter. Modified as listed in the file header: estimation on a block-averaged copy with the field evaluated at the block centres, float64 arithmetic, separable refinement, fixed sample blocks fitted on at most Workers workers from the shared concurrency budget, voxels at or below zero left out of the mask.

The 2 x 1024-entry HT decoder lookup tables vlcTbl0 and vlcTbl1 inverted into the 444 + 358 normative CxtVLC codewords of ISO/IEC 15444-15 (context, rho, u_off, e_k, e_1, codeword, length) in a new Go representation; no code was taken. The encoder and decoder tables of internal/htj2k are built from these records, and OpenJPEG 2.5.4 and OpenJPH 0.32.0 decode the resulting codestreams bit-exactly (docs/JPEG2000_ENCODER.md).

artifacts.transformation: Modified port to Go: Vincent's hybrid reconstruction, flood-based regional extrema, and the h-maxima, h-minima, h-convex, h-concave and fill-hole marker constructions, over x-fastest float32 volumes with explicit 6/18/26 neighbour offsets, reconstruction by erosion through negation, one-sample axes excluded from the border, voxel budgets and context cancellation; the file keeps an attribution header listing the modifications.

Modified port to Go of Beucher's and Meyer's marker flooding: the per-level FIFO map becomes one heap ordered by (level, insertion sequence) with the same pop order, 6/18/26 connectivity, an optional flood mask, unreached and line-voxel counts, 16-bit label volumes, voxel budgets and context cancellation; the file keeps an attribution header listing the modifications.

The 122784-byte Brotli static dictionary (RFC 7932 Appendix A) stored as raw bytes and embedded by internal/brotli for JPEG XL brob boxes and jbrd tail data. Its SHA-256 is the one RFC 7932 states for the dictionary; the bytes are the kBrotliDictionaryData array of c/common/dictionary.c (v1.1.0 snapshot, also the comparison baseline recorded by the same author's Isis DICOM Viewer provenance). The decoder in internal/brotli is written from RFC 7932 and copies no Brotli code.
